If your household is eligible for the PHG, SC and SPR members (if any) of the core family nucleus will receive the grant based on their eligible share. It will be credited into their CPF Ordinary Accounts. The PHG received by core applicants can be used to: Offset the purchase price of the flat Reduce the housing loan required for the flat purchase Occupiers will not be able to use their CPF savings (including any housing grants received) for the flat purchase, servicing of the housing loan, etc.
